text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At last, I have proven myself the<n>strongest
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Raise your voices high and fix your<n>eyes on me as I
forge on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will show you an even more glorious<n>victory...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come and watch me outpace even<n>the seniors!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Emperor's declaration of war is<n>greeted by the
most deafening cheers<n>of the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, as you may well have<n>gathered...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I intend to leverage this victory into<n>entering the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Participation is decided by popular<n>vote, so even
being invited is a mark<n>of prestige.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But, as I'm certain you know by now,<n>that will not
suffice. Nothing less than<n>victory will satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha... As you command.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: As we resolve to fix our sights on the<n>Arima Kinen...
I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good work out there, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian. It's not often you come to<n>watch me
race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was interested in seeing who the<n>strongest
Umamusume was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And as expected, it's you. Looks like<n>the Kikuka
Sho was no sweat for the<n>Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I could hardly presume to give you<n>orders if I
wasn't.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go toe-to-toe with you<n>someday. You
look like an opponent<n>worth sinking my teeth into.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By all means. I'm confident I can<n>weather a gentle
nibble.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough of that. Is Air<n>Groove not with
you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was egotistical of me to<n>assume that she
would be watching...<n>Or could it be that she has
something<n>to attend to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You know, probing people isn't really<n>your speed.
You make it too obvious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's not what I—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried she won't follow<n>you if you don't
keep an eye on her?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Never mind. Congrats on the win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Get some rest. You've earned it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You know, Trainer... About what Brian<n>just said—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm from the newspaper.<n>Do you have
a minute?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. Just give me a moment to<n>get ready.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We can pick this up later. The press is<n>calling.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Between this win and my future<n>ambitions, I have
plenty for them to<n>get excited about.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, however, Symboli Rudolf<n>winds up
swamped with interviews,<n>and we never get the
chance to have<n>that talk.
